files.name: class-server.js
files.content:
// The class Share server. The deployed worker address goes here once, and every projector page and phone page in class-11 reads it. Open a projector page with ?shareHost=https://your-server.workers.dev on the end of its address to use a different server for one run.
window.CLASS_SHARE_HOST = 'https://p5-phone-share.npuckett.workers.dev';

files.name: index.html
files.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>04 Show of Hands, Networked: Projector</title>
  <style>
    body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #141414;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- a phone that opens this projector page goes to the phone page instead, with the same
       server and room. Add ?projector=1 to use a phone as the projector on purpose. -->
  <script>
    (function () {
      var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
      var phone = window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches && Math.min(screen.width, screen.height) < 700;
      if (phone && !q.has('projector')) location.replace('https://digitalfuturesocadu.github.io/f26-atelier1-examples/class-11/04-show-of-hands-networked/phone/' + location.search);
    })();
  </script>

  <!-- the class server address, set once in class-11/class-server.js -->
  <script src="class-server.js"></script>

  <!-- p5.js 2.x -->
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5@2.2.3/lib/p5.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5.js-compatibility@0.2.0/src/preload.js"></script>

  <!-- p5-phone: Share, and the join code -->
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5-phone@1.15.4/dist/p5-phone.min.js"></script>

  <!-- the join code, the phone count and the connection state -->
  <script src="join-panel.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <script src="sketch.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
